title: Public restroom, ground floor (sample inspection)
description: Five measured items. `expected_outcome` and `expected_section` are for evaluation only; the checklist flow never reads them.

items.question: What is the minimum clear width of a door opening?

items.element: Water closet grab bars: height to top of gripping surface
items.question: At what height above the floor must grab bars be installed?
How high must the seat of a water closet be above the floor?
What is the minimum width of knee clearance under a lavatory?
items.note: 30 inches wide minimum (306.3.5). Width, not height: the 2010 Standards define knee clearance height only as the zone between 9 and 27 inches (306.3.1), not as a pass/fail minimum

items.question: What is the maximum running slope of a ramp?
